source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Hi, [FREELANCER_NAME_001] only now found the time to sit down and open the files on my laptop. Unfortunately, the colour codes doc will not open because it displays an error. The jpgs and pdfs open without any problems, but I’m unable to open the AI, EPS, or PSD files. For the png files, only logo 4 opens correctly; none of the others open properly. Also, when we create the website and other materials, which font should we use? Did you use an existing font, or did you create it? If you created it, which font would complement the logo or potentially match it for uses such as some headers? Thanks, [CLIENT_NAME_001]

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
Hi [CLIENT_NAME_001],

Thank you for reviewing the files and reporting the problems.

The PSD file requires Adobe Photoshop to open, while Adobe Illustrator—or another compatible vector editing program—is needed for the AI and EPS files. Without those applications installed, the files won't open as intended.

I'll investigate the PNG files that aren't opening correctly and provide fixed versions.

Regarding the font, all of the logo lettering was custom-made rather than derived from a particular font. However, I can recommend a closely similar font that pairs well with the logo and would work for the website, headings, and other branding materials while keeping the visual identity consistent.

Let me know if you'd like me to recommend a few font options.

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer states that all logo lettering was custom-made rather than derived from a particular font.
